items.title: INV-051 MEL-dose Goldilocks rigidity sweep: does behavioural rigidity trace a U-shape (elevated at BOTH under-stimulation AND overload extremes, lower at mid-dose) across a >=3-level graded MEL-dose sweep via the real SD-MEL-PRODUCER->SD-MEL-CONSUMER->SD-017 sleep-loop pathway?
items.note: GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = per-seed rigidity DV (post-training behavioural policy entropy on a fixed novel probe) scored across a >=3-level MEL-dose sweep for a U-shape (not a monotone trend). Grepped REE_assembly/evidence/experiments for claim_ids=INV-051: 0 run manifests (only aggregator/index files mention the string). No compatible substrate_hash carries this combination -- V3-EXQ-845/861/861a use MECH-180's consolidation-AMOUNT DVs (sws_n_writes/rem_n_rollouts/sws_slot_diversity), not a behavioural-flexibility readout, and none sweep more than a high-vs-low MEL contrast ecologically -> not recoverable -> run. SUBSTRATE READINESS (2.5/2.5a): SD-017 (IMPLEMENTED 2026-04-09), SD-MEL-CONSUMER (IMPLEMENTED 2026-07-07, PROVEN via V3-EXQ-718a injection), SD-MEL-PRODUCER (VALIDATED V3-EXQ-798a, confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-798a_2026-07-30) all IMPLEMENTED/VALIDATED per ree-v3/CLAUDE.md. One-tick empirical probe (this session, throwaway scratch script) confirmed: CausalGridWorldV2(world_rule_shift_enabled=True, interval=10, depth in {2,3}) constructs/steps cleanly with the documented info fields; depth=3 produces more distinct re-permuted action-maps than depth=2 (19/20 vs 13/20 over 20 shifts), supporting depth as a graded OVERLOAD-arm magnitude knob; REEAgent(use_mel_consumer=True, use_sleep_loop=True, sws_enabled=True, rem_enabled=True) constructs with mel_consumer/sleep_loop live; one waking step + force_cycle() returned the exact keys this driver reads, and mel_duration_factor reached the FACTOR_MAX=3.0 ceiling in that quick probe (the saturation mechanism the OVERLOAD arm leans on is empirically reachable). No doc-vs-runtime drift found. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (2.5b): 0 failure-autopsy targets tag INV-051 at all (script-verified count) -> brake N/A. SUBSTRATE-PATH OVERLAP GATE (2.5c): substrate_queue.json has 0 OPEN entries carrying a substrate_paths field at all -> nothing to overlap with. ETHICS PREFLIGHT (2.6): all-false/allow (V3 harm/residue streams are pre-ethical instrumentation, SENT-0); see manifest ethics_preflight block. DESIGN: 6 arms x 3 seeds. 5 ecological ON arms span INV-051's own two failure modes plus a mid/optimal region using SD-MEL-PRODUCER's validated interval ladder (798a: 0/60/25/10, depth=2) for the first four rungs (ARM_0_MONOTONY_ON interval=0 depth=0, ARM_1_LOW_ON interval=60 depth=2, ARM_2_OPTIMAL_ON interval=25 depth=2, ARM_3_HIGH_ON interval=10 depth=2), extended by ONE further rung at the SAME validated interval=10 but depth=3 (ARM_4_OVERLOAD_ON, empirically probed in 2.5a, not a new untested knob) to operationalise 'MEL exceeding consumer clearance capacity' via the consumer's FACTOR_MAX clamp. ARM_5_OVERLOAD_OFF (interval=10 depth=3, mel_on=False) is a non-load-bearing C2 control mirroring V3-EXQ-845's pattern. FALSIFYING-CONDITION-(c) CONTROL built into the design rather than a separate ablation arm: agent.sleep_loop.force_cycle() fires MEAS_CYCLES times in EVERY ON arm regardless of measured MEL, and mel_duration_factor is clamped to [FACTOR_MIN=0.5, FACTOR_MAX=3.0] -- sleep OPPORTUNITY/architecture is identical across every dose arm by construction (asserted + recorded as readiness precondition R3), so an apparent low-MEL rigidity reading cannot be explained by 'less sleep happened'. RIGIDITY DV (pre-registered, load-bearing): post-measurement behavioural policy entropy on a FIXED, NOVEL, held-out probe env (seed distinct from the arm's training env, world_rule_shift OFF) -- rigidity_index = 1 - H/H_max over the 5-way action distribution. HOLD-WEIGHTED E3 READOUT FIX (found by validate_experiments.py this session, DISQUALIFYING for an entropy-shaped DV per its own guidance): the primary tally is gated on ticks['e3_tick'] (fresh selections only, not HELD-action repeats from E3's cadence, default 10) to avoid confounding decision diversity with E3-cadence differences across arms; n_fresh_select/n_latched/fresh_select_yield are recorded, the hold-weighted (as-executed) variant is kept as a clearly-labelled non-load-bearing diagnostic, and a new readiness precondition R4 (minimum MIN_FRESH_SELECTIONS_PER_CELL=15 fresh selections per cell) was added. C1 (LOAD-BEARING, the U-shape test): per seed, sort the 5 ON arms by MEASURED mean_mel; LOW=idx0, MID=idx2 (median of 5), HIGH=idx4. delta_low=rigidity[LOW]-rigidity[MID], delta_high=rigidity[HIGH]-rigidity[MID]; margin_low/high = max(RIGIDITY_SD_MULT=2.0 * pstdev(delta across ready seeds), RIGIDITY_MIN_EFFECT_FLOOR=0.05) per the feedback_effect_size_pass_gate_margin convention (scale noise on SD of the DELTA, never the baseline level, plus an absolute floor -- same pattern as V3-EXQ-680b SUPERADD_MIN_EFFECT_FLOOR). COMBINATION RULE (explicit, Step 3.5): C1 is CONJUNCTIVE -- both extremes must independently clear their own margin vs mid, each on >=2/3 seeds; a single elevated extreme alone routes to a distinct 'partial_ushape'/mixed label, not a confirmed U-shape. FALSIFYING per INV-051's own what_would_answer: rigidity monotonic in dose on >=2/3 seeds, OR neither extreme clears margin (flat) -> both route to evidence_direction=weakens. DV-SYMMETRY (604c check, declared in full in the script docstring): the manipulation trains genuinely different agent.e2 weights per arm (via the recon-only P0 loop) and differentially scales SD-017 consolidation content via the MEL-consumer; rigidity_index is read post-hoc from the LEARNED select_action() output on a fixed probe, not a tick-level transform of one shared already-fixed scoring function -- not invariant under any of the three documented symmetry classes (broadcast constant / monotone rescale / permutation of interchangeable units). OUT OF SCOPE per the claim's own what_would_answer: MECH-171 (already out_of_domain), MECH-178 NA/cortisol/LC coupling (no such substrate exists in ree_core) -- not required for a verdict on the core U-shape, not built here. STALE PROPOSAL NOTE (auditability, not touched by this run): a stale (2026-07-08) parked proposal EXP-0376/backlog_id EVB-0111 for INV-051 exists in REE_assembly/evidence/planning/experiment_proposals.v1.json; its release_condition partially assumed a non-converging graded-MEL env did not yet exist (it now does -- SD-MEL-PRODUCER) and separately named the MECH-178 NA plane as a release condition, which this run's freshly-digested what_would_answer explicitly puts out of scope. Reconciling EXP-0376 is left to a separate governance pass. SLEEP DRIVER: manual-cycle-loop (force_cycle() once per cycle). Smoke PASS (dry-run, 3-arm subset MONOTONY_ON/OVERLOAD_ON/OVERLOAD_OFF, 1 seed: no crash, manifest+sentinel written, dry-run-relocated with no evidence/ leak; validate_experiments --strict 0 findings incl. arm_fingerprint on a fresh origin/main worktree; DV-variation-across-arms hard-assert PASSED, n_distinct_rigidity_values=2 (0.6045 MONOTONY vs 0.6891 OVERLOAD); progress instrumentation correct). Landed via throwaway worktree off origin/main (shared ree-v3 checkout was 6-ahead+behind-54 and dirty with other sessions' live WIP; the first push attempt from an earlier worktree fork was rejected non-fast-forward and rebuilt fresh off a later origin/main tip rather than manually merge-resolving the queue-file conflict).

items.title: INV-034/Q-021 goal-maintenance-agency (onboarded): C6 z_goal measurement-harness fix (run_p2 contact-gated peak)
items.note: Driver-only measurement-harness correction of V3-EXQ-866a (supersedes it). 866a's C6 (c6_pass=0, zgoal_norm_mean_FULL=0.1198) was a MEASUREMENT ARTIFACT: its _measure_866_style rolled its own P2 readout that called update_z_goal unconditionally every step and averaged ||z_goal||, so GoalState's per-step decay (decay_goal=0.005) washed z_goal to ~0.12 on the near-zero-contact P2 env. The substrate preserves z_goal through the whole curriculum (enters P2 ~0.52; the scheduler's own contact-gated run_p2 reports z_goal_norm_peak_max ~0.52 with n_decay_only=0). 866c keeps G0/C1-C5 identical to 866a (behavioral pass unchanged, bit-identical) and reads C6 from scheduler.run_p2's z_goal_norm_peak_max (restoring post-P1 z_goal before run_p2). C6 gates on peak_max NOT z_goal_norm_at_contact_peak: G0 fails (FULL forages below RANDOM), so contact is near-zero and contact_peak would spuriously fail C6 for a z_goal that IS maintained; peak_max is robust to that foraging confound (peak_max is the wanting-pathway-engagement readout, orthogonal to G0/C4). PRIMARY BLOCKER remains G0 (foraging-competence, GAP-2/Stage-H ceiling), reported honestly; NOT expected to PASS overall (G0 gates first). G0 routed separately to chip-20260808-g0-foraging-competence-autopsy; sibling V3-EXQ-899 is the G0-readiness re-run. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive contact-gated z_goal_norm_peak_max readout is not recorded on any compatible manifest (866a recorded only the decaying mean) -> run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b): literal count=2 (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-866 + _866a) but NOT braked -- 866 is substrate_not_ready_requeue (action=none, a re-run rec) and 866a is substrate_ceiling with action=none (no build owed, names the G0/Stage-H foraging path); the brake remedy (route /implement-substrate) is inapplicable and 866a's ceiling reading was partly driven by the very C6 artifact this fixes. USER-AUTHORIZED instrument-repair (decision chip chip-20260808-scaffolded-c6-misdiagnosis-routing option A, 2026-08-08); instrument-defect carve-out applies. DV-SYMMETRY: the FULL-vs-AVOIDANCE_ONLY ablation is a structural removal of the whole wanting pathway (z_goal presence + goal-conditioned per-candidate selection bias), NOT a broadcast scalar/monotone rescale/permutation -- it genuinely moves argmax/softmax selection, so no arm's DV is invariant under it. Diagnosis: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/scaffolded_curriculum_hazard_rebalance_diagnosis_staged_2026-08-08.md (REE_assembly 5521a31df5). Smoke PASS (dry-run: FULL peak_max 0.52/0.48/0.41 >0.4, AVOIDANCE_ONLY 0.0 <0.1, contact_peak 0.0 confirms peak_max is the right gate). [chip_ref: chip-20260808-v3exq866c-c6-run-p2-fix]

items.title: MECH-457 H-consummation-binding calibrated re-run (crash-fix: anchor-reachability threshold was a raw floor, not a fraction)
items.note: CRASH-FIX successor to V3-EXQ-821a (ERROR, exit 1, no manifest, 2026-08-08T11:17:11Z on ree-cloud-3), diagnosed via /diagnose-errors. Root cause: assert_anchor_reachable() was called with threshold=float(POST_BC_INSTALL_FLOOR) (=10.0, a raw competence-floor value) where the function requires a FRACTION of reference cells (0.0-1.0) -- no fraction can ever clear 10.0, so the guard was structurally unmeetable regardless of anchor quality and crashed at setup (AnchorUnreachable) despite both live anchors (local_view_greedy=34.167, greedy_oracle=42.8) clearing the real floor with wide margin. Fixed via a dedicated POST_BC_ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_THRESHOLD=1.0 constant, matching sibling MECH-457 scripts 788/789/792/792a. Everything else unchanged from 821a: DIAGNOSTIC re-test of the currently-ALIVE competence_floor leg H-consummation-binding (821 eliminated reading VOIDED as an instrument artefact, competence_floor_instrument_audit_2026-08-07 sec 3d; leg reset to alive 2026-08-07). Calibrated re-run per competence_floor_recurrence_repose_2026-08-08 sec 4. FIX vs 821 (carried from 821a): BC install dose 300->1200; USABLE install readiness floor 10.0 not the trivial 1.0; foraging RATE (resources/tick) reported alongside composite resources/episode. Verified: reproduced the exact crash + confirmed the fix resolves it against the real recorded anchor values; --dry-run smoke test passes (dry-run skips the fixed code path by design, so the direct repro is load-bearing, not the smoke test alone).
